description: This file defines the class 'actionModifyRecord', which extends 'actionCreateRecord', and provides functionality for modifying records within the SuiteCRM system, including UI rendering and run-time execution logic.

classes.name: actionModifyRecord
classes.description: Class for modifying records within SuiteCRM, including rendering UI components and executing modification logic.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Returns JavaScript code necessary for the client-side functionality associated with record modification.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Generates the HTML markup and JavaScript for displaying the record modification interface.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the record modification action, updating linked records or the specified record based on parameters.
